title: Fleet Vehicles and Commercial Use under Brake Service Warranties
content:
**Terms for business and fleet customers.** Holding a Crestline Fleet Account changes Brake Service Warranties coverage on the fleet's vehicles.

1. A line whose warranty does not apply on a vehicle in commercial use (the lifetime lines) covers nothing on a date when the vehicle is in commercial use, and its warranty is voided once the vehicle is recorded in commercial use.
2. The limited lines and the Severe-Duty line cover commercial vehicles on their own terms.
3. When a brake job is charged to a Crestline Fleet Account, the fleet brakes discount applies only where the line's setting allows the fleet discount.

**When a vehicle is in commercial use.** A vehicle is in commercial use on a date when, as the records stand on that date, the vehicle's usage class is commercial, or its most recent roster entry on a Crestline Fleet Account is an enrolment of that vehicle on the roster. Otherwise it is not in commercial use.

| Vehicle record on the date | Most recent Crestline Fleet Account roster entry for the vehicle | In commercial use? |
|---|---|---|
| usage class commercial | any, or none | Yes |
| usage class not commercial | an enrolment on the roster | Yes |
| usage class not commercial | a removal from the roster | No |
| usage class not commercial | none | No |

**Effect by kind of line.**

| Line | Vehicle in commercial use on the date of the visit | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| a lifetime line | Yes | the warranty covers nothing on that date, and it is voided once the vehicle is recorded in commercial use |
| a limited line or the Severe-Duty line | Yes | covered on that line's own terms |
